arizona.headline: Desert heat. Undimmed optimism.
arizona.story: It's a dry heat and a stubborn kind of hope. Deep red up top, black lettering, and a shirt light enough for a 105 degree tailgate.
arizona.occasion: Good for September games that still feel like July.

atlanta.headline: Red, black, and another reason to believe.
atlanta.story: Black shirt, red letters, and a strict policy of never leaving early. Hope runs hot down here.
atlanta.occasion: Made for watch parties where nobody sits down.

baltimore.headline: Purple pride. High expectations.
baltimore.story: Purple so deep it's nearly midnight, with black letters that mean business. This city doesn't do quiet confidence. It does the loud kind.
baltimore.occasion: Wear it to the harbor, the office, or anywhere a rival might see it.

buffalo.headline: Layers on. Hopes up.
buffalo.story: Royal blue, red letters, and a crowd that treats a snowstorm like a home-field perk. You've been saying it for years. Say it with a folding table nearby.
buffalo.occasion: Built for parking lots at 9 a.m. in December.

carolina.headline: A fresh season looks good in blue.
carolina.story: Black shirt, that bright electric blue, and two states' worth of patience. The Carolinas keep the faith politely, then loudly.
carolina.occasion: For Sundays that start with barbecue arguments and end with football ones.

chicago.headline: Cold days. High hopes.
chicago.story: Navy and orange, same as the wind chill warning. Hope here comes bundled in three layers and doesn't complain about it.
chicago.occasion: For lakefront Sundays when your breath is visible and so is your optimism.

cincinnati.headline: Orange looks good on a fresh start.
cincinnati.story: Black shirt, orange letters, zero subtlety. The river city has waited a long time and is done being quiet about it.
cincinnati.occasion: Pairs well with chili that outsiders will never understand.

cleveland.headline: Brown, orange, and belief that keeps showing up.
cleveland.story: Brown and orange, the only color pairing that's also a personality. Nobody believes harder for longer than this town, and nobody's earned the shirt more.
cleveland.occasion: For the lot before kickoff, where the real hope lives.

dallas.headline: Another season. The same bold declaration.
dallas.story: Navy shirt, silver outline, and the confidence of someone who has said this every August for decades. Everything's bigger here, including the expectations.
dallas.occasion: For the friend who starts planning the parade in preseason.

denver.headline: Orange skies. Big expectations.
denver.story: Navy and orange at a mile up, where the air is thin and the hope is not. Altitude is your home-field advantage. Use it.
denver.occasion: For crisp fall Sundays with mountains in the background.

detroit.headline: Wear the blue. Bring the belief.
detroit.story: That bright blue with a silver outline, worn by people who never stopped showing up. This city builds things. Belief is one of them.
detroit.occasion: A good Thanksgiving shirt. You'll be watching anyway.

green-bay.headline: Green and gold, whatever the forecast.
green-bay.story: Dark green, gold letters, and a town small enough that everybody owns one. The forecast says frozen. The shirt says otherwise.
green-bay.occasion: Goes under a parka. Still counts.

houston.headline: A fresh chapter in your colors.
houston.story: Deep navy and a loud red, built for humidity and big talk. The city's huge, the hopes are bigger, and the air conditioning is doing its best.
houston.occasion: For tailgates where the brisket went on the night before.

indianapolis.headline: Blue, white, and all-in optimism.
indianapolis.story: Blue shirt, white outline, no extra noise. Simple colors for a simple message you repeat every single fall.
indianapolis.occasion: For game days that start downtown and end with your voice gone.

jacksonville.headline: Teal with something to prove.
jacksonville.story: Teal like the water, black letters, gold outline. A young football city with a short memory and a long supply of hope.
jacksonville.occasion: Works at the beach, at the game, and everywhere in between.

kansas-city.headline: Red and gold. Ready for more.
kansas-city.story: Red shirt, gold letters, and smoke in the air from every direction. Around here the tailgate is half the game and belief is the other half.
kansas-city.occasion: For Sundays that smell like burnt ends.

las-vegas.headline: Black and silver. Full commitment.
las-vegas.story: Black shirt, silver outline, nothing else needed. In a city built on long odds, saying this out loud barely counts as a gamble.
las-vegas.occasion: For the trip, the game, and the story you tell after.

los-angeles-powder.headline: A little sunshine. A lot of belief.
los-angeles-powder.story: Powder blue and sunshine gold, the happiest-looking colors in football. The outlook's bright even when the standings aren't.
los-angeles-powder.occasion: For 75 degrees in December and no apologies about it.

los-angeles-royal.headline: Royal blue. Golden expectations.
los-angeles-royal.story: Royal blue, yellow letters, and Hollywood-level confidence. Every season's a sequel and you're sure this one's better than the last.
los-angeles-royal.occasion: For game day, then tacos, in that order.

miami.headline: Bright colors. Brighter expectations.
miami.story: Aqua and orange, the only colors that work at a beach and a tailgate. Sunburned, hydrated, and absolutely certain about this year.
miami.occasion: For September games played inside a sauna.

minnesota.headline: Purple, gold, and a reason to layer up.
minnesota.story: Purple and gold for the land of ten thousand lakes and nearly as many close calls. Up here, hope is a winter sport.

new-england.headline: New season. Familiar conviction.
new-england.story: Navy shirt, red letters, six states sharing one opinion. The standard's high up here and nobody's lowering it.
new-england.occasion: For fall Sundays that start with cider donuts.

new-orleans.headline: Gold looks good on optimism.
new-orleans.story: Black and old gold, in a city that turns every Sunday into a parade whether or not there's a reason. Belief isn't a mood here. It's a lifestyle.
new-orleans.occasion: For second lines, watch parties, and any day ending in y.

new-york-blue.headline: True blue. Bigger hopes.
new-york-blue.story: Deep blue, red letters, and the patience of someone who takes a train to another state for a home game. Loud, loyal, and sure about this one.
new-york-blue.occasion: For the ride out to Jersey and the long ride home.

new-york-green.headline: Green means give it another go.
new-york-green.story: Green and white, worn by the most stubborn optimists in the tri-state area. Saying it's our year takes nerve. You've got plenty.
new-york-green.occasion: For anyone who's said this through things that would've broken a lesser fan.

philadelphia.headline: Midnight green. All-day belief.
philadelphia.story: Midnight green, black letters, and a city that boos because it cares. The passion's free. The cheesesteak argument costs extra.
philadelphia.occasion: For Broad Street, the lots, and your cousin's wedding if it lands on a Sunday.

pittsburgh.headline: Black and gold, from kickoff onward.
pittsburgh.story: Black and gold, same as the bridges and most of the town. Three rivers, one opinion, zero doubt.
pittsburgh.occasion: For Sundays when the whole city wears the same two colors.

san-francisco.headline: Red and gold. Expectations included.
san-francisco.story: Red shirt, gold letters, and fog rolling in right on schedule. The Bay's seen plenty of good years and fully expects another.
san-francisco.occasion: Bring a layer. It's always colder at the game than you think.

seattle.headline: Navy, green, and ready for another chapter.
seattle.story: Navy, loud green, and a crowd known for making the ground shake. Rain's just atmosphere when you're this sure.
seattle.occasion: For coffee at dawn and noise by kickoff.

tampa-bay.headline: Bring the red. Bring the belief.
tampa-bay.story: Red shirt, pewter letters, and a bay full of people on boats saying the same thing you are. Sunshine helps the optimism grow.
tampa-bay.occasion: For game days that end on the water.

tennessee.headline: A blue-sky outlook for the next kickoff.
tennessee.story: Navy and that light sky blue, with a soundtrack coming out of every doorway on Broadway. Music City knows a comeback story when it hears one.
tennessee.occasion: For Sundays with a honky-tonk on either side of kickoff.

washington.headline: Burgundy, gold, and a fresh declaration.
washington.story: Burgundy and gold, the colors of a fanbase with a very long memory. New chapter, same declaration, said with a straight face.
washington.occasion: For the faithful who never stopped showing up.
